skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the general concepts and history of internal controls.
Identify and explain the components that make up internal control systems.

Apply internal control principles to various business processes such as purchasing and payment cycles, sales and revenue collection, payroll and human resources, fixed assets management, and cash management.
Understand how internal controls operate within modern technological environments.
Critically assess the application and implementation of internal controls in organizations.
Develop systematic thinking skills to analyze, evaluate, and solve problems related to internal controls.
Develop basic computer skills using Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Articulate and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches in organizing internal controls.
